\caption{\bt{Accuracy (\%) of the user agent by data change, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, over three independent runs per method (\ScenCells\ runs, \ScenValidTasks\ scored tasks, \ScenAgentHours\ agent-hours). Small numbers give the range of the three runs where they differ; a red frame marks a cell in which at least 25\% of the tasks used a stale definition, i.e., one whose canonical SQL answers that setting's questions incorrectly. The covered breaks target key uniqueness (status rows, restated sales, duplicate load), join cardinality (SCD Type 2), and date-key completeness (date-key format). Right: accuracy over all covered breaks with its 95\% interval, and definitions invalidated and repairs published per run by the methods that invalidate on data changes.}{按数据变化划分的用户端智能体正确率（\%），DeepSeek V4.1 Flash，每种方法 3 次独立运行（共 \ScenCells\ 次运行、\ScenValidTasks\ 道计分题、\ScenAgentHours\ 智能体小时）。小字为 3 次运行不一致时的范围；红框表示该格中至少 25\% 的题使用了过期定义，即其规范 SQL 在该情形下答错的定义。条件覆盖的破坏分别针对键唯一性（状态变更行、多版本更正、重复加载）、连接基数（缓慢变化维）和日期键完整性（日期键格式）。右：全部覆盖的破坏上的正确率及其 95\% 区间，以及随数据变化而失效的方法每次运行的失效数与发布的修复数。}}
\label{fig:scenarios}
\Description{A result matrix with one row per method and one column per setting. Rows: no memory; example retrieval; example retrieval with self-verification; invalidate on schema change; invalidate on every write; full recheck per definition; MAVRA (ours), outlined; MAVRA with the regression test on current data; MAVRA with a gold-SQL reference. Columns are grouped as none (held-out), benign updates (append, late arriving, in-place fix, new column), breaks covered by a condition (status rows, restated sales, duplicate load, SCD Type 2, date-key format), and outside the guarantee (unit change, backup copy), followed by accuracy over all covered breaks and, per run, invalidations and repairs. No memory answers 0 to 67 percent. Every sharing method answers 100 percent on held-out questions and almost always on the benign updates. Under status rows MAVRA, every write, and full recheck answer 100, example retrieval 50, self-verification 61, schema change 50 with a red frame; under restated sales MAVRA 93, full recheck 100, every write 89, example retrieval 78, schema change 78 framed; under duplicate loads MAVRA 59, example retrieval 37, schema change 44 framed, every write 33; under SCD Type 2 all sharing methods 100, schema change framed; under the date-key format all methods 7 to 22. Unit change 44 to 52, with red frames on the methods that keep definitions across writes; backup copy 50 to 72, example retrieval highest. Over all covered breaks: no memory 19, example retrieval 57, self-verification 63, schema change 59, every write 69, full recheck 74, MAVRA 73 (69 to 76), regression on current data 72, gold-SQL 73. Per run, every write invalidates 40 definitions and repairs none; MAVRA invalidates 25.7 and repairs 10.3; full recheck 21.3 and 8.7; regression on current data 21.0 and 4.7; gold-SQL 20.7 and 9.0.}
